subject: world
title: Four Seasons Mystery
objective: Name the four seasons and match seasonal clues (clothes, weather, nature).

story_beats.text: Bobo found four photographs — but the labels fell off! 'What do you NOTICE in each picture?'

interactions.prompt: Trees are bare and everyone's wearing sweaters. Which season?
Mangoes are ripe and the sun is blazing. Which season?
Leaves turn red and fall. Which season?

feedback.correct: Season detective! Bobo is filing this case as SOLVED!
feedback.retry: Look at the clues — clothes, trees, sun. What do they tell you?

off_screen: Look out of the window. Which season is it? Find 3 clues.
